readme_excerpt:
# blockbench-cli

A command-line tool for batch-converting Blockbench `.bbmodel` files between formats. Supports Bedrock geometry, Java OptiFine JEM, Hytale `.blockymodel`, and a few legacy formats.

## Installation

```bash
npm install -g blockbench-cli
```

## Usage

```bash
blockbench-cli convert input.bbmodel --to hytale --out ./out
blockbench-cli convert input.bbmodel --to bedrock --textures ./textures --out ./out
blockbench-cli batch ./models --to hytale --recursive
```

## Supported formats

- Blockbench `.bbmodel` (input)
- Bedrock geometry JSON
- Java OptiFine JEM
- Hytale `.blockymodel`

## Note

This is a standalone CLI tool. There is no Claude Code integration, no MCP server, no plugin. Run it from a terminal.
